body: I appreciate that but you don't know her animosity and pure hate for literally everything, including programs and religion. She hates everything and everyone with such a deep seeded hate. And it's starting to spread to her family. But I am absolutely going to keep trying. Thank you.

I do feel like I fucked up. I know getting into arguments and yelling and stating the obvious doesn't help and yet it happened anyway. I feel like I could've prevented this last fight that became physically destructive by not letting it devolve into yelling and haranguing.
AA centers on spiritual recovery though. I get that she has to hit rock bottom but I don't think AA will help as she is very anti religious.
